page.layout: One column of running text, set in the middle of the page. Page number at the head. No running head, no marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword. Left and right edges show only edge fragments and show-through.

main_text.p: Argumentum efficacissimum fuerit. Synodus e Patriarchis, & Episcopis Schismaticis, improbis, rebellibus, percontumacibus, ideoque condemnatis & excommunicatis a Concilio legitimo, & vniuersali coacta, & celebrata Synodus legitima non est, sed Co-ciliabulum, & nequissimorum hominum congregatio, nec vllum in Ecclesia pondus, vel momentum habet, nec robur. Sed Synodus illa Photiana, Octava dicta, coacta fuit, & celebrata a Schismaticis, rebellibus, condemnatis, & excommunicatis a pluribus Synodis, & quod peius est in schismate, & excommunicatione persistentibus. Ergo Synodus illa neque valida est, neque legitima, sed nequissimorum hominum adumbratum commentum. Maior etiam Græcorum Schismaticorum est. Qua enim ratione, qui extra Ecclesiam sunt, & ab eadem reiecti, & veluti membra noxia excommunicatione etiam signati de rebus Ecclesiasticis decernent? Quæ extra nos sunt, nihil ad nos. Minor dictis eiusdemmet Synodi probatur, ex qua satis aperte elicitur, non Patriarchas solum, sed Episcopos omnes in ea congregatos, etiam post condemnationem Photij, & excommunicationem a pluribus Synodis latam, Photij continuo vnionem, quidquid Rom. Pontifices aliiq; Episcopos, Epi-sco-

page.notes: Printed hyphens at line ends kept as printed: "Schismati-", "Co-" (in "Co-ciliabulum"), "Epi-", "sco-". The reading "aliiq;" for "alijq;" follows the i/j rule (vowel i) and should be checked against the scan. "Octava" is read from the printed "Octaua". The text ends mid-word at "sco-" and continues on the next page. The "A" of "Argumentum" is a large initial, printed with a gap ("A rgumentum"), and is joined here. Spots, stains and a bullet in the text are not transcribed.
